mapper.sql: (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM crm_deal_team team WHERE team.tenant_id = oa_contract.tenant_id AND ((team.biz_type = 'CONTRACT' AND team.biz_id = oa_contract.contract_id) OR (team.biz_type = 'RECEIVABLE' AND team.biz_id IN (SELECT receivable.receivable_id FROM crm_receivable receivable WHERE receivable.tenant_id = oa_contract.tenant_id AND receivable.contract_id = oa_contract.contract_id)))) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM crm_deal_event event WHERE event.tenant_id = oa_contract.tenant_id AND ((event.biz_type = 'CONTRACT' AND event.biz_id = oa_contract.contract_id) OR (event.biz_type = 'RECEIVABLE' AND event.biz_id IN (SELECT receivable.receivable_id FROM crm_receivable receivable WHERE receivable.tenant_id = oa_contract.tenant_id AND receivable.contract_id = oa_contract.contract_id)))) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM outbox_event source WHERE source.tenant_id = oa_contract.tenant_id AND source.aggregate_id = oa_contract.contract_id AND source.aggregate_type = 'cloudflow-service-oa' AND source.event_type = 'CONTRACT_PERFORMANCE_CHANGED') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM oa_invoice_writeoff writeoff WHERE writeoff.tenant_id = oa_contract.tenant_id AND writeoff.business_type = 'CRM_RECEIVABLE' AND writeoff.business_id IN (SELECT receivable.receivable_id FROM crm_receivable receivable WHERE receivable.tenant_id = oa_contract.tenant_id AND receivable.contract_id = oa_contract.contract_id)))
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM oa_contract WHERE contract_id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
